provenance.origin: already-interpreted findings summarised from the cited papers; tests judgment over supplied summaries, NOT reproduction from raw data

program: TNNI1 → TNNI3 troponin I isoform switch
in_vitro_finding: hiPSC-CMs predominantly express the fetal/slow-skeletal isoform TNNI1; TNNI3 (adult cardiac) is low and increases only with prolonged culture or maturation cues.
in_vivo_finding: Adult heart is TNNI3-dominant; the TNNI1→TNNI3 switch is a standard maturation index.
